body.voice_description: Create an original chess-coach voice for an illustrated character. Character: Curious collaborator from Chennai who explores alternatives with the player. Voice direction: Lighter male tenor with a modern Indian English accent. Quick, curious pivots, an encouraging upward lift and crisp, friendly explanation. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: What if we check the defender first? Once it moves, that piece is unprotected and can be taken. Compare that with keeping it where it was.
